description: Independently selectable complete cases or families; seven primary contract groups and separate level, input, oracle, and purpose metadata; all existing tests and six full campaigns retained.

result.validation: Source-only family registry enumeration and exact per-family membership/order comparison; native validation is owned by root
result.prior_audit_gap: The previous audit checked the global ordered 684-ID partition using manually supplied family slice boundaries. It did not derive each family's own count from its source expression. An off-by-one count split computationTests at17 rather than18 and assigned its last action to hygieneTests; total/order checks could not detect the boundary error.

static_enumeration_method.method: Tokenize list/constructor/map/append source expressions; read only Pair label fields and treat IO actions as opaque; no candidate executable output or MLF action execution supplies expected values.
source_only_adapter_details: Readability outer let-rec is parsed as a recursive local binding scope; its recursive helper is only used inside opaque action fields.
Modules.rejects constructor-pattern parameter is parsed as ModuleRejection(label,libraries,input,expected,reason), preserving its source-derived label prefix.
IntSetUnions single C.toLegacy mapping uses its literal C.test display name from source; its action remains opaque.

families.notes: 800 seeded map updates (seed 17), ascending/descending order comparison, association-list oracle, deliberate unused panic values.
All 32 by 32 subset pairs use scalar membership/value formula; demand probes retain panic sentinels.
1200 seeded updates (seed 17) against independent sorted association list; rotations, arbitrary-precision keys and lazy poison values.
22 fixed threshold/use/shadowing assertions; panic sentinels detect traversal past size/occurrence budgets.
Seven fixed optimized-AST checks cover projections, recursive sharing, fresh binders, partial constructors and conflicting arity evidence.
Five LLVM builder/codegen checks count successful force instructions and scope isolation across definitions/branches/cases.
Fixed field-inference cases and generated lowering check retain laziness, canonical-WHNF and capture-boundary assertions.
Fixed implicit/no-implicit-prelude, shadowing/free-name and source structural equality checks.
21 checks include target print/parse preservation, bit-exact doubles, rejected nonfinite values, capture avoidance and alpha-renamed/deep binders.
Fixed parser/layout/desugaring/class-lowering/name-collision fixtures retain rejection cases and source-structure comparisons.
Large cursor/radix/comment/indentation counters plus a poison accumulator for malformed digits.
100001 builder increments retain strict counter/stack behavior and lazy poison prefixes/instruction fields.
Direct primitives, partial applications, lazy/error order, IO recursion/arrays, invalid IO entry and division-by-zero outcomes.
Runtime environments, state actions, mutable arrays, lazy poison values, invalid regions/handles and exact errors.
All Cases.stateTypeCases/stateTargetCases remain; source compilation, target print/parse and erasure/type-preservation checks.
Complete small graph enumeration, eight flag variants and nine equations; frozen GraphReference plus incremental/full solver comparison.
GraphScopesReference remains; renamed/sparse/huge identities, 32 generated containment graphs and 15708 comparisons, demand sentinels and graft guards.
12000 graph validation inputs, flag/equation products, sparse/reference unification and explicit rename-commutation checks.
Frozen oldVisit and OrderedTraversalReference remain; 16 seed graphs, translated/negative/reversed IDs and full root/state/prefix products, poison/infinite-prefix probes.
Old checked route independently rebuilds solver indexes/target; seven full source/module fixtures and deliberately corrupt index/graph finish failures.
Two graphs at three identity offsets; independent originalType/originalBounds recursion never calls cached helpers.
35000-node binding-index graph and two 1000-wide complete solver variants retain ordinary-stack regression boundaries.
Complete histories(4), gap/alias/old-node cases, seven annotations, conservation and idempotence; external fixture reuses the algorithm, so it is not labeled independent-reference.

InferenceReference produces the exact fixed source corpus and expected observed acceptance/type/rejection rows; byte-identical generated input and Fig12-A8 REJECT Inference guard retained. This is cross-route differential evidence, not an independent inference implementation.

all_individual_families.timing_scope: Each family runs in a fresh process and work directory, reusing already built suite/driver/runtime artifacts and independently checked Port targets. Times cover the actual selected process and all its actions, excluding artifact build/preparation. No test results are reused.

limits: Full campaign runs preceded the data-only correction of one adjacent Core family boundary. Their actions, full family sets, exact aggregate golden inventories and compiler/runner binaries are unchanged; all161 migrated families were subsequently validated independently against the final corrected catalog.
Parity and self-host were not rerun; the entire parity-through-selfHost action section remains byte-for-byte unchanged. Existing fresh-candidate provenance requirements remain in force.

The validation commands ran serially on this macOS arm64 host. Campaign and root-selection command times include builds and execution with a progressively warmed shared cache; individual-family times have the separate execution-only scope stated in their record. These are not an isolated speed comparison.
Primary-group and method labels describe complete reviewed families. Selection does not sample their generated inputs or replace existing assertions and independent oracles.

The initial cross-language query selected only Backends because its integration-level Core family was excluded by the component-level filter. The corrected cross-language-corrected query separately proves a two-unit selection.
